messages:
Lina (People Ops): Quick sync  Arjun is overseas and needs H-1B visa stamping. We need to decide whether to ship passport to counsel for consulate dropbox or have him attend an interview. Counsel asked for timeline. Thoughts?

Arjun (New Hire): I can do interview if needed but earliest appointment available in my city is 3 weeks out. DropBox is possible if my case qualifies. What's the risk of waiting?

Olivia (Immig Legal): If the case is eligible for dropbox (previous visa in same category, no refusals), that's fastest: counsel can courier passport to local consulate on your behalf for stamping. Interview adds travel/time. Dropbox often takes ~7-10 business days. Need original passport and signed cover letter.

Priya (Recruiter): Hiring timeline: we'd like Arjun's start by May 4. If we do interview in 3 weeks, plus administrative processing maybe another 1-2 weeks, that pushes start later. Dropbox with express courier aligns better.

Arjun (New Hire): Okay I can ship passport. Any special docs I should include? I can also keep travel plans flexible.

Olivia (Immig Legal): Please include: passport, I-797, H-1B approval notice copy, DS-160 confirmation page, signed HR attestation (link below). Notarization not required for consulate in your country. We'll provide DHL prepaid label to your address.

Lina (People Ops): Action: we'll generate DHL Express label and book pickup. Arjun please drop at local DHL service point by end of day tomorrow. Priya, update start date contingency if stamping delays.

DHLBot (bot): Pre-paid label created: DHL-ARJ-2026-5566. Pickup window for Arjun's city: 2026-04-08 09:00-17:00 local. Estimated transit to counsel: 3 business days.

Arjun (New Hire): Label received. I'll drop at the DHL center at 16:30 today. One Q: should I include a return envelope with extra postage?

Olivia (Immig Legal): Yes please include a pre-paid return envelope; counsel will return stamped passport via secure courier. Also include a copy of your travel itinerary only if you have immediate travel needs.

Lina (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Priya, please set start as "tentative May 4" and note visa stamping in candidate tracker. Arjun, upload a scan of passport and DS-160 to Ripley and add tracking once you drop off.

Arjun (New Hire): Done  uploaded scans and dropped the package. Tracking DHL-ARJ-2026-5566 now shows "Picked up".

DHLBot (bot): Shipment update: DHL-ARJ-2026-5566 picked up 2026-04-07 16:43 local. ETA counsel: 2026-04-10.

Olivia (Immig Legal): Logged shipment and added to docket: H1B-STAMP-ARJ-2026. We'll update once passport is returned. If there are any consulate requests, we'll notify immediately.

Priya (Recruiter): Noted. I'll keep candidate calendar flexible and confirm final start within 48 hours of passport return. :thumbsup:

Lina (People Ops): Great, thanks team. Please paste the final courier receipt here when you have it and tag the expense "immigration-shipping".
